sources.entry: Discourse - Advanced forum / community solution based on Ruby and JS. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-2.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Discourse is an open-source, self-hostable community forum platform with topic discussions, built-in real-time chat, themes, and plugins.
summary.what_it_does: Discourse provides topic-based discussion forums where members create topics and hold conversations. It includes built-in real-time chat, a selection of official and community themes for customizing the look, and a plugin system (the README mentions a chatbot plugin powered by Discourse AI and a Data Explorer plugin for SQL analysis). The back end is a Rails JSON API, and the front end is an Ember.js app. The README points to a Docker-based development setup and a single install command for self-hosted production, with a separate Install Guide for more detail. The README also describes an official paid hosting option with a Free plan.
use_cases: host discussion boards for a group
add real-time chat to a forum
how_to_run: Development: follow one of the setup guides in the README (Docker with Dev Container in VS Code or CLI, macOS, Ubuntu/Debian, Windows)
Requires Ruby 3.4+, PostgreSQL 15, and Redis 7 for a manual setup
Self-hosted production: run the single install command shown in the README (wget ... | sudo bash)
Read the Discourse Install Guide for beginner and advanced production setups
notable: Real-time built-in chat alongside topic discussions
Official and community themes plus a plugin ecosystem, including Discourse AI chatbots and the Data Explorer plugin
Rails JSON API with an Ember.js front end
Official managed hosting option as an alternative to self-hosting
caveats: The README's one-line install command is truncated and does not show the URL, so exact install steps must be taken from the Install Guide
Self-hosting requires managing your own server, with setup and maintenance; the README recommends official hosting for those who want to skip this
Requires Ruby 3.4+, PostgreSQL 15, and Redis 7 for a manual development setup
